description: The navigation set of SvGrid UI in Svelte 5: SvBreadcrumb with a trail that collapses in the middle when long, SvPagination with a page range that shows ellipses, first and last and previous and next buttons, and SvStepper for a linear wizard with completed, active and upcoming states. All are keyboard accessible and theme-token driven, and the pagination range math lives in the framework-free paginationRange helper.

faq.question: How does the pagination decide which pages to show?
faq.answer: paginationRange({ page, pageCount, siblings }) returns the page numbers and ellipsis markers around the current page; SvPagination renders it, and you can use the helper for your own pager.

faq.question: How does the breadcrumb collapse?
faq.answer: With maxItems set and more items than that, the middle ones fold into an expandable ellipsis so the root and the current page stay visible.

faq.question: Can a stepper step be clicked?
faq.answer: Yes when onChange is provided. In linear mode only completed steps and the active one are clickable; otherwise any step is.
